record_type: Executed verification of published saved outputs; awaiting human review
command_note: Run from the pinned EGRA checkout; output destination is normalized to avoid machine-specific paths.
data_file_set_hash_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON: sorted list of {path,sha256} entries from saved-artifacts.json, sorted by path, json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")), no trailing newline.
limits: Checks committed outputs, not EEG preprocessing, model inference, or historical execution.
Raw-DE nuisance summaries have no committed row-level classification predictions.
Fingerprint predictions omit feature_type; their four labeled summary rows are not recomputed.
Segment top-5 and within-true-video metrics are aggregated from saved flags; the full similarity/ranking arrays are absent.
Snapshot hashes establish current file identity, not original run provenance.
